verdict.rationale: Apify's own API v2 docs describe webhooks that fire on platform system events, such as an Actor run finishing or failing, and send an HTTP request to another service. These are first-party, registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The evidence is limited to short snippets. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the event-type catalog, payload format and registration flow, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks provide an easy and reliable way to configure the Apify platform to carry out an action (e.g. a HTTP request to another service) when a certain system event
you can use webhooks to start another Actor when an Actor run finishes or fails.
